resources.string: All your favorite anime and manga in one place, with AniList integration and extension support!
Could not sign in. Please try again.
Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
No connection to AniList. Check your internet and try again.
That token did not work. Check that you copied all of it.
The AniList client is not set up (anilist.clientId).
Paste an AniList access token below. This is for those who prefer not to use the browser window, or when the return to the app does not work.

1. At anilist.co/settings/developer, create an app and set https://anilist.co/api/v2/oauth/pin as its redirect URL.\n2. Open https://anilist.co/api/v2/oauth/authorize?client_id=YOUR_ID&response_type=token and authorize it.\n3. Copy the token shown on the page and paste it here.
Your password stays protected at AniList!
Sign-in happens directly on the official AniList website, in a browser window. You type your password there, and Kaisou never has access to it!

AniList does not split permissions into parts, so the authorization it grants covers almost the whole account. Don\'t worry: Kaisou uses this access only to show and update your lists, your progress and the activity of the people you follow.
Where is your access key kept?
It is saved only on this device! Kaisou does not use its own servers, and this data is not included in Android backups.
Want to disconnect? You can revoke Kaisou\'s access at any time, right from your AniList account settings.
